text:
zoe_sales: FYI new POC with Meridian Finance is stuck. They requested Dedicated capacity in eu-west1 with AZ affinity to eu-west1-b, but provisioning fails with GPU inventory errors and also the customer project hit external IP soft limits. Need SE + infra swarm.
liam_se: Can you paste the error from the control plane?
zoe_sales: Customer screenshot from our console:```Provision failed: NoAvailableGPUs: requested 4xH100 in zone eu-west1-b, available 0. Fallback to other zones disabled by 'az_affinity: required'.```Another message:```External IP allocation failed: Quota 'STATIC_ADDRESSES' exceeded for project 'meridian-prod'.```
ana_cs: They also asked procurement for a one-off 10-day burst price versus a 12-month reserved commit. Also Security wants to confirm we support customer-managed keys and that audit logs can be forwarded to their Splunk instance. Quick yes/no will unblock the questionnaire.
liam_se: Pricing quick note: 12-month commit discounts ~30% on unit GPU-hour price vs on-demand burst. One-off 10-day burst will be billed at on-demand; ballpark estimate for 4xH100 is ~€28k/day on-demand (placeholder). I'll refine once infra confirms availability.
sam_infra: Two separate problems: (1) Region/zone GPU inventory — H100 are scarce in eu-west1-b right now. (2) Project IP quota — we can request the customer to increase static IP quota or use ephemeral private endpoints. I'll try a lower-GPU attempt and a zone fallback if allowed.
liam_se: Customer insists AZ affinity so they can keep PCI scope minimal. That limits our fallback options. If AZ affinity is strict, we must escalate to cloud provider capacity request.
zoe_sales: Can infra attempt to provision a smaller footprint so they can at least run model sanity tests? Maybe 1xH100 or 2xT4 for smoke tests?
sam_infra: Running attempt:```rdwctl provision --dedicated --region eu-west1 --zone eu-west1-b --gpus 1 --type h100 --affinity required``` -> infra-bot: [provision] req=mr-0043, status=allocation_failed, reason="NoAvailableGPUs"
liam_se: Try a permissive fallback config (affinity=preferred) to test, but we need customer sign-off to relax affinity. If they can't, open provider ticket.
ana_cs: I can ping the customer for temporary relaxation for smoke tests. But security said they can't accept compute outside eu-west1-b without written approval.
sam_infra: Ok opening provider capacity ticket. Opening support case with cloud provider now referencing GC-9872. ETA typical: 6-48 hours for GPU capacity, can be longer. Also opening quota increase for STATIC_ADDRESSES — that one usually <2 hours once validated. I'll post both ticket IDs.
infra-bot: [support-ticket] id=GC-9872, type=capacity_request, region=eu-west1-b, status=open
infra-bot: [quota-ticket] id=Q-4421, quota=STATIC_ADDRESSES, status=open, requested=+50
liam_se: For procurement: give them the rough delta for approval: 10-day burst of 4xH100 on-demand ~€280k total (very rough). Reserved 12-mo commit would amortize to ~€15k/week. Mark as provisional.
zoe_sales: Customer wants an option: can we offer a temporary Dedicated pool in eu-west1-c and VPC peering to meet network controls? They claim peering+strict routing equals same residency.
liam_se: Peering moves traffic but compute locality still differs; for strict PCI/regulatory controls that often fails audit. We can propose it as a temporary engineering workaround but need Sec approval.
nana_cs: Security quick answer: "Yes 
- Dedicated supports CMEK (customer-managed keys) via supported KMS integrations;
- Audit logs for inference and admin actions can be exported to a customer Splunk endpoint or cloud logging export; retention configurable.
Contact security@redwood.com for formal attestation and SOC2 artifacts."
zoe_sales: Thanks. Customer replied they'll wait 24 hours for provider response but asked if we can at least allocate a private-only endpoint in eu-west1-b (no external IP) for internal smoke tests if capacity opens.
sam_infra: Once capacity is available we'll try to allocate with no external IP to avoid STATIC_ADDRESSES quota. Also suggest trying smaller accelerator (e.g., 2xA100 or T4) if customer's workload tolerates lower perf for validation.
liam_se: Also note we can offer a 'burst reservation' alternative: reserve a smaller steady commit in eu-west1-b and allow on-demand burst up to N GPUs. That requires finance approval but could reduce risk.
zoe_sales: Please coordinate finance/partners to get a short quote for '1-month small commit + bursting' and post here. Customer needs numbers for procurement.
nana_cs: I'll attach the sec snippet to the questionnaire now.
infra-bot: [provision] req=mr-0043b, attempt=2, config="2xA100, private-only, zone=eu-west1-b" -> status=allocated, endpoint=10.5.92.11
zoe_sales: Great — they got a private-only 2xA100 node. Customer says internal testing passed but end-to-end fails without external IPs. They've authorized us to request the STATIC_ADDRESSES quota increase.
sam_infra: Quota ticket Q-4421 updated: provider accepted request, new quota +50 pending validation. ETA ~45min. I'll tag you when it flips.
infra-bot: [quota-ticket] id=Q-4421, status=approved, new_limit=60
sam_infra: Allocating allocated nodes with external IP now:```rdwctl attach-external-ip --endpoint 10.5.92.11``` -> infra-bot: [ip-assign] ip=35.198.77.123, status=assigned
zoe_sales: Customer can run e2e tests now. They'll confirm tomorrow but asked for final pricing table for: 2xA100 private-only test, 4xH100 10-day burst, 12-month commit for 4xH100. Liam can you post numbers?
liam_se: Will prepare concise table once I finalize with pricing ops. For now: 2xA100 test = ~€1.2k/day, 4xH100 10-day burst ~€280k total (on-demand), 12mo commit estimate ~50% discount vs burst in this SKU - I will firm numbers.
nana_cs: Security: sent questionnaire with snippet and SOC2 request contact.
zoe_sales: Thanks everyone. Please keep me posted on the provider ticket and final quote. I'll relay to Meridian procurement. :raised_hands:
